defmodule PaymentVault do
  @moduledoc "Encrypted payment processing with recursive batch settlement"

  @aes_key :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
  @iv_size 16
  @max_batch_depth 10_000

  defstruct [:merchant_id, :transactions, :settlement_stack, :depth_counter]

  def new(merchant_id) do
    %PaymentVault{
      merchant_id: merchant_id,
      transactions: [],
      settlement_stack: [],
      depth_counter: 0
    }
  end

  def encrypt_card(card_number) when is_binary(card_number) do
    iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@iv_size)
    padded = pkcs7_pad(card_number, 16)
    encrypted = :crypto.crypto_one_time(:aes_256_cbc, @aes_key, iv, padded, true)
    {:ok, iv <> encrypted}
  end

  def decrypt_card(ciphertext) when byte_size(ciphertext) > @iv_size do
    <<iv::binary-size(@iv_size), encrypted::binary>> = ciphertext
    decrypted = :crypto.crypto_one_time(:aes_256_cbc, @aes_key, iv, encrypted, false)
    {:ok, pkcs7_unpad(decrypted)}
  end

  def process_payment(vault, %{amount: amount, card: card_enc, ref: ref}) do
    case validate_amount(amount) do
      :ok ->
        tx = %{amount: amount, card_token: card_enc, ref: ref, status: :pending}
        updated = %{vault | transactions: [tx | vault.transactions]}
        {:ok, updated}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  def settle_batch(vault) do
    pending = Enum.filter(vault.transactions, &(&1.status == :pending))
    do_settle_recursive(vault, pending, [])
  end

  defp do_settle_recursive(vault, [], settled) do
    updated_txs = Enum.map(vault.transactions, fn tx ->
      if Enum.any?(settled, &(&1.ref == tx.ref)) do
        %{tx | status: :settled}
      else
        tx
      end
    end)
    {:ok, %{vault | transactions: updated_txs, settlement_stack: settled}}
  end

  defp do_settle_recursive(vault, [tx | rest], settled) do
    new_depth = vault.depth_counter + 1
    if check_depth_limit(new_depth) do
      case settle_single(tx) do
        {:ok, settled_tx} ->
          updated_vault = %{vault | depth_counter: new_depth}
          do_settle_recursive(updated_vault, rest, [settled_tx | settled])
        {:error, _reason} ->
          do_settle_recursive(vault, rest, settled)
      end
    else
      {:error, :depth_exceeded}
    end
  end

  defp check_depth_limit(depth) do
    depth <= @max_batch_depth
  end

  defp settle_single(%{amount: amount, ref: ref} = tx) do
    Process.put(:settlement_frame, {ref, amount, System.monotonic_time()})
    frame_data = build_settlement_frame(tx)
    push_to_stack(frame_data)
    {:ok, %{tx | status: :settled}}
  end

  defp build_settlement_frame(%{amount: amount, card_token: token, ref: ref}) do
    hmac = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @aes_key, "#{ref}:#{amount}")
    alloc_size = compute_frame_size(amount)
    frame_buffer = :binary.copy(<<0>>, alloc_size)
    %{ref: ref, hmac: hmac, buffer: frame_buffer, size: alloc_size}
  end

  defp compute_frame_size(amount) when is_integer(amount) do
    base_size = 256
    min(base_size + (amount * 8), 4096)
  end

  defp compute_frame_size(amount) when is_float(amount) do
    base_size = 256
    min(base_size + (trunc(amount) * 8), 4096)
  end

  defp push_to_stack(frame_data) do
    existing = Process.get(:vault_stack, [])
    Process.put(:vault_stack, [frame_data | existing])
  end

  defp validate_amount(amount) when is_number(amount) and amount > 0 and amount <= 100_000, do: :ok
  defp validate_amount(_), do: {:error, :invalid_amount}

  defp pkcs7_pad(data, block_size) do
    pad_len = block_size - rem(byte_size(data), block_size)
    data <> :binary.copy(<<pad_len>>, pad_len)
  end

  defp pkcs7_unpad(data) do
    pad_len = :binary.last(data)
    if pad_len > 0 and pad_len <= 16 do
      binary_part(data, 0, byte_size(data) - pad_len)
    else
      data
    end
  end

  def get_stack_depth do
    Process.get(:vault_stack, []) |> length()
  end

  def clear_stack do
    Process.delete(:vault_stack)
    Process.delete(:settlement_frame)
  end
end

defmodule PaymentVault.BatchProcessor do
  @batch_limit 5_000

  def run_settlement(merchant_id, transactions) do
    vault = PaymentVault.new(merchant_id)

    vault_with_txs = Enum.reduce(transactions, vault, fn tx_params, acc ->
      case PaymentVault.process_payment(acc, tx_params) do
        {:ok, updated} -> updated
        {:error, _} -> acc
      end
    end)

    if length(vault_with_txs.transactions) <= @batch_limit do
      result = PaymentVault.settle_batch(vault_with_txs)
      PaymentVault.clear_stack()
      result
    else
      {:error, :batch_too_large}
    end
  end
end
